title: Grilled Chicken Ravioli in Creamy Basil Ricotta Sauce
description: Cheese ravioli served in a silky basil-ricotta-Parmesan cream sauce with grilled chicken, mushrooms, cherry tomatoes, mozzarella pearls, and fresh basil.
steps: Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning. Grill or pan-sear over medium-high heat until golden and cooked through, about 5–6 minutes per side. Rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the ravioli until just al dente. Reserve 1/4 cup pasta water before draining.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Sauté the mushrooms until lightly browned. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the heavy cream and simmer gently for 2–3 minutes.
Whisk in the ricotta cheese until completely smooth.
Add the Parmesan cheese and stir until melted.
Blend the fresh basil into the sauce using an immersion blender (or blend separately and return to the pan) until the sauce is smooth and lightly green.
Season with Italian seasoning, salt, and freshly cracked black pepper.
Add the cooked ravioli and gently toss to coat. Add a splash of reserved pasta water if needed to loosen the sauce.
Fold in the sautéed mushrooms and half of the mozzarella pearls.
Transfer to serving bowls and top with sliced grilled chicken.
Garnish with cherry tomatoes, remaining mozzarella pearls, fresh basil leaves, extra Parmesan, optional green olives, and a few small dollops of basil pesto.
notes: Whole milk ricotta produces the creamiest sauce.
Fresh basil should be blended into the sauce rather than cooked for a long time to preserve its vibrant flavor and color.
Use freshly grated Parmesan; pre-shredded cheese does not melt as smoothly.
A spoonful of basil pesto just before serving intensifies the basil flavor.
Serve with garlic bread, focaccia, or a simple arugula salad.
